title: “Maths is easy – tú ya sabes!”
style: reggaeton pop rap, Miami Spanglish, 128 BPM, male rap lead, smooth female harmonies, group chants, bilingual hook, Latin trap drums, dembow groove, tropical percussion, brass stabs, clap backbeats, heavy sub-bass, pop chorus drops, punchy studio mix, stereo vocal stack, sunny party energy, sing-rap delivery.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey amigo, tú ya sabes… Maths is EASY, you already know!
Numbers everywhere in your life, just watch the rhythm flow!
No books, no stress – you do it every day,
Maths is simple magic – now let’s show the way!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes Maths, it’s EASY, you already know!
Add, subtract, multiply – it’s all in the flow!
Like cooking in the kitchen, fractions on the plate,
Maths is everywhere, no need to calculate!
Shopping for the discount, percentages so sweet,
Driving down the highway, speed and distance meet!
You already know Maths – it’s natural, it’s fun,
Tú ya sabes Maths – let’s sing it, everyone!

[Verse 1 – Cooking Analogy]
En la cocina you measure without a degree,
Half the recipe, quarter the sugar – fractions easy!
Grams of rice, liters of water, volume in the pot,
You balance the flavors – maths is what you got!
Like cutting a pizza, slices are the key,
You already divide it perfectly!

[Chorus]
Tú ya sabes Maths, it’s EASY, you already know!
Add, subtract, multiply – it’s all in the flow!

[Verse 2 – Shopping & Money Analogy]
At the store the discount is 30% off the price,
You calculate the savings quick – no need for advice!
Budget in your pocket, adding up the total bill,
Subtract what you spent – maths gives you the thrill!
Interest on your savings, growing every day,
You already know percentages – it’s child’s play!

[Verse 3 – Driving & Travel Analogy]
En el carro the speedometer shows velocity,
Distance over time – you feel it naturally!
Miles to the beach, time left on the clock,
You estimate the arrival without a single shock!
Fuel in the tank, average miles per gallon,
Maths in every trip – it’s built right in, mi gente!

[Bridge – Music & Sports Analogy – beat drops hard]
Wait… you thought maths was hard? Nah, look at the beat!
Music is pure maths – BPM, rhythm so sweet!
Sports on the field, stats and the score,
You track the points, probability in the roar!
Patterns in the waves, symmetry in the palm trees,
Nature does the maths – it’s effortless, feel the breeze!

[Verse 4 – Nature & Games Analogy]
On the beach the sand forms perfect geometry,
Symmetry in the shells, angles you can see!
Games with your crew, chance and probability,
You guess the winner – maths is your ability!
Building with your hands, area and the space,
You already measure life at your own pace!

[Verse 5 – Everyday Life Analogy]
From morning coffee ratio to the playlist song,
Maths hides in the simple – where you belong!
No problema with numbers, they’re your daily friend,
Important decisions? Maths helps you win!
Flexible mind, possible dream come true,
You already know Maths – it’s inside of you!

[Chorus – bigger, full group vocals + claps + crowd cheers]
Tú ya sabes Maths, it’s EASY, you already know!
Add, subtract, multiply – it’s all in the flow!
Like cooking, shopping, driving, music too,
Sports, nature, games – maths is part of you!
No stress, no fear, just pure celebration,
You know more Maths than you ever imagined!

[Outro – chant style, big tropical drop + fade]
Tú ya sabes Maths… it’s EASY, you already know…
Numbers make life better, watch the whole world flow!
Maths in the kitchen, maths on the street,
Maths in the music – can’t be beat!
¡Sumar! ¡Restar! ¡Fácil! ¡Celebración!
You already know Maths – ¡eso es la verdad!
Tú ya sabes… tú ya sabes… Maths is EASY, let’s go!
